meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are counts of facts read from law firms' own public websites and from official open registries on the dates shown, kept for research and marketing planning. Each row's two coverage measures say how much of the market it reaches. The counts describe what websites and registries say, not the quality of any firm or lawyer. A firm can ask us to correct its row or to be left out through the data corrections page; we act within 7 days.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

changes.summary: Version 2.0.0, read up to 2026-10-28: 61,694 law firms found in 51 of the 51 jurisdictions (6,540 with a website read, 55,154 from official registries only); aggregates CC BY 4.0, firm rows ODbL files.
